_comment: Income-tax facts behind the DCF tax-normalization input (added 2026-10-04). Every percentage is transcribed from Oracle's FY2026 Form 10-K rate reconciliation (income taxes note, the table 'for the year ended May 31, 2026', p. 96) and cross-checked by validate-data.mjs against the SEC XBRL facts in xbrl_facts.json (concept keys in `xbrl`). The state line is not shown separately in FY2026 (folded into 'Other adjustments', which the 10-K footnote says includes 'state taxes, net of federal benefit'); the latest year with a separate state line is FY2025. `normalized` is the DCF default for a normalized rate: the US federal statutory rate plus the latest separately disclosed state line. Nothing here is estimated.

source.title: Oracle Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2026, income taxes note, rate reconciliation (ASU 2023-09 format)

fy2026.pretax_note: derived: US$4,106 M tax at the 21% statutory rate ÷ 0.21 (the reconciliation table states the amount, not the base)

lines.en: Foreign tax effects (Switzerland, Malta, Bermuda, other jurisdictions)
lines.es: Efectos fiscales en el extranjero (Suiza, Malta, Bermudas, otras jurisdicciones)

lines.en: Effect of changes in tax laws or rates enacted in the period (U.S. One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act)
lines.es: Efecto de cambios en leyes o tasas promulgados en el periodo (One, Big, Beautiful Bill Act)

lines.en: Tax credits (federal R&D −3.2 pp, foreign tax credits −4.9 pp)
lines.es: Créditos fiscales (I+D federal −3.2 pp, créditos por impuestos extranjeros −4.9 pp)

lines.en: Nontaxable or nondeductible items, of which stock-based compensation −10.6 pp
lines.es: Partidas no gravables o no deducibles, de las cuales compensación en acciones −10.6 pp
Cambios en beneficios fiscales no reconocidos

lines.en: Other adjustments (valuation allowances, cross-border tax laws and state taxes net of federal benefit; California, Virginia and Missouri are the majority of the state taxes)
lines.es: Otros ajustes (reservas de valuación, leyes fiscales transfronterizas e impuestos estatales netos del beneficio federal; California, Virginia y Misuri son la mayoría de los impuestos estatales)

state.note_en: State tax expense, net of federal benefit, FY2025 (the latest year the 10-K shows it as a separate line): US$128 M on US$14,162 M of pretax income (US$2,974 M ÷ 0.21) = 0.9 pp. FY2024: US$81 M, 0.7 pp.
state.note_es: Impuesto estatal, neto del beneficio federal, AF2025 (el último año en que el 10-K lo muestra por separado): US$128 M sobre US$14,162 M de utilidad antes de impuestos (US$2,974 M ÷ 0.21) = 0.9 pp. AF2024: US$81 M, 0.7 pp.

source.title: Oracle Form 10-K FY2026, income taxes note, reconciliation for the years ended May 31, 2025 and 2024

normalized.method_en: US federal statutory rate (21.0%) plus state taxes net of federal benefit (0.9 pp, FY2025 line). Credits, the excess tax benefit on stock-based compensation and foreign rate differentials are treated as non-recurring in the steady state; unrecognized-benefit and enacted-law effects are one-time.
normalized.method_es: Tasa federal estatutaria (21.0%) más impuestos estatales netos del beneficio federal (0.9 pp, línea del AF2025). Los créditos, el beneficio fiscal excedente de la compensación en acciones y los diferenciales de tasa extranjeros se tratan como no recurrentes en el estado estable; los efectos de beneficios no reconocidos y de leyes promulgadas son únicos.

quarterly_note: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateContinuingOperations as tagged (discrete quarters where Oracle tags them; FY2026Q4 is not tagged separately). The page's LTM rate is computed from the four reported quarters' provision ÷ pretax income.
